column1: # Slovenian (sl) interface catalog. Columns, separated by a TAB:
#   context    usually empty. `preview` words sample text inside rendered previews (the Design
#              tab's style-set tiles), which must fit a small tile; it falls back to the plain entry.
#   source     the English text exactly as in the code (tl!(...), ribbon labels, command labels)
#   escapes    \n  \t  \\  inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns, and a
#              trailing "…" in one needs one in the other.
#   Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored. A missing entry shows in English.
# Clean room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label in ordinary
# Slovenian computing vocabulary. No Microsoft Word (or other product) localisation, string table
# or translated UI was consulted or copied; add entries the same way.
# Ribbon tabs, groups and panes are nouns (Vstavljanje, Pisava, Podokno slogov); commands and
# buttons use the imperative (Shrani, Vstavi tabelo); messages address the user with the polite
# plural (Shranite dokument). Only the first word of a label is capitalised. Product, format and
# technology names stay as they are (WordCraft, PDF, Markdown, MCP …). Counts use count-neutral
# wording (`Besede: 21`), so no plural forms (dvojina, množina) are needed. Quotes are »…«.
